# Ashlr Stack

> Configure supported services from your terminal or your AI agent. MIT-licensed. Pre-alpha.

This is the repo entry point for agents. The published short index is https://stack.ashlr.ai/llms.txt and the full reference is https://stack.ashlr.ai/llms-full.txt. In this checkout those files are `packages/site/public/llms.txt` and `packages/site/public/llms-full.txt`.

## Read-only commands

No account. These print JSON and write nothing. Node.js 20 or newer matches the engines field of the published 0.3.1 packages.

```bash
npx -y -p @ashlr/stack stack providers --json
npx -y -p @ashlr/stack stack recommend "B2B SaaS with auth, AI, and payments" --json
npx -y -p @ashlr/stack stack scan --json
npx -y -p @ashlr/stack stack templates list --json
```

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL stack.ashlr.ai/install.sh | bash
```

Windows (PowerShell): `irm https://stack.ashlr.ai/install.ps1 | iex`

After install, `stack onboard --json` prints a plan and writes nothing. `stack doctor --ecosystem --json` only reports which Ashlr tools are installed.

## MCP server

Claude Code:

```bash
claude mcp add ashlr-stack -- npx -y -p @ashlr/stack -p ashlr-stack-mcp ashlr-stack-mcp
```

Codex:

```bash
codex mcp add ashlr-stack -- npx -y -p @ashlr/stack -p ashlr-stack-mcp ashlr-stack-mcp
```

Cursor (`~/.cursor/mcp.json` or `.mcp.json`):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ashlr-stack": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "-p", "@ashlr/stack", "-p", "ashlr-stack-mcp", "ashlr-stack-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Do not run `stack add`, `stack apply`, `stack import`, or `stack onboard --apply` until the user names the project and the provider.
